rationale: The raw schedule separates Portfolio Company from Type of Investment, Investment Date, Maturity Date, and Interest Rate. In table 15 row 12, the Portfolio Company cell is Augmented Reality Concepts, Inc., while the extracted issuer_name in the bundle includes schedule grouping text plus the secured-loan, date, maturity, and interest-rate fields. That is a real issuer-name formatting/extraction defect, not a false alarm.
